Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰에서 성과를 낸 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 데이브를 태워주겠다고 제안했다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After a successful quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> offered to give me a ride on Dave.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼で成果を出した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、デイヴを乗せていくことを提案した。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 在委托中取得成果的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>提议要用戴夫载我一程。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 在委託中取得成果的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>提議要用戴夫載我一程。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir réussi la quête, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a proposé de m'embarquer sur Dave.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nachdem <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bei der Mission erfolgreich war, bot sie an, mich auf Dave mitzunehmen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de la misión, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se ofreció a llevarme en Dave.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Após o sucesso da missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ofereceu uma carona em Dave.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ผู้ทำภารกิจสำเร็จ เสนอจะพาดีฟไปส่ง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah berhasil menyelesaikan misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menawarkan tumpangan pada Dave.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi thực hiện nhiệm vụ thành công, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã đề nghị cho tôi đi nhờ Dave.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: मिशन में सफलता हासिल करने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने डेव पर सवारी कराने की पेशकश की।
